messages:
Priya: hey team, quick heads up — my flight just got moved up, need someone to take primary for the 02:00-04:00 UTC window tonight. I can stay secondary/monitor but won't be able to respond to pages quickly.
Alex: I can cover the 02:00-03:00 UTC slot, then need to hand off to someone else. not ideal but doable.
Sam: I can pick up 03:00-04:00 UTC if Alex covers the first hour. will be online and available for escalation.
Priya: thanks both. alex -> sam handoff ok? please confirm you'll call out any ongoing incidents during the swap.
Alex: yep. i'll annotate in the pager log and post the handoff note. plan: check open alerts, clear any stale silences, run quick health check.
Sam: pinged the runtime dashboard, no active p99 spikes right now. will keep it on 30s refresh during my window.
Ops Bot: incident-bot assigned: oncall-change requested by @Priya. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/oncall/prim-sec-handback. to confirm assignment run: `/rota assign --primary Sam --secondary Alex --until 2233445780`
Priya: thanks Ops Bot — i'll leave the runbook checklist here for the handoff: 1) check active pagers 2) verify ML infra green (gpu-util < 85%) 3) confirm fallback model route healthy 4) verify KV cache warms.
Alex: running checklist now. outputs: `gpu-util: 62%`, `p99-latency: 210ms`, `kv-cache-hit: 78%`. no active pagers.
Sam: confirmed, i've received the rota assignment notif. i'll be primary from 03:00-04:00 UTC and will escalate to Alex if anything looks hairy.
Priya: leaving a short note in #incidents in case anything pops while i'm on a plane: "Priya OOO 02:00-04:00 UTC, Alex then Sam covering. Ping Alex for infra, Sam for runtime. Runbook link above."
Alex: left a handoff blurb in the ticketing triage too. also added temporary alert threshold tweak for embeddings-prod mem pressure (+10%) while the flight turbulence window hits our infra delta.
Sam: got it. i'll monitor telemetry and will run the consumer throttle script if we see token-drop > 5%: ```./scripts/consumer-throttle.sh --target embeddings-prod --pct 15```
Priya: appreciate it. can one of you create a short post-swap confirmation here once the schedule flips so I know it's landed before takeoff?
Alex: will confirm at 02:00 UTC when i actually take primary.
Sam: will confirm at 03:00 UTC when i take over.
Ops Bot: reminder: please annotate the handoff in the rota and set a follow-up ping at 04:15 UTC to verify everything returned to normal.
incident-bot: monitor alert: embeddings-prod p50 latency elevated earlier but resolved — no active incidents.
Alex: now primary (02:00 UTC). all checks looked normal at takeover. briefed Sam in DMs.
Sam: now primary (03:00 UTC). telemetry steady, no customer-impacting alerts. keeping 5m cadence on charts.
Priya: thanks both — i'm boarding now. will keep my phone muted but reachable for urgent mentions. safe handoff.
